recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. If the practitioner job title extension needs future wording or metadata refinement, make that change in hl7.fhir.uv.extensions rather than in the core FHIR checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-17621 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for PA. The accepted resolution changed the original roleTitle-element request into a new standard jobTitle extension: CodeableConcept 0..1 with an example value set, available on PractitionerRole and Practitioner, for job titles that may be independent of role.
initial_application: Core commit c2d19685c9 added the practitioner-job-title extension, CodeSystem, ValueSet, and Practitioner implementation-guide registration. The extension used Practitioner and PractitionerRole contexts, CodeableConcept value[x], and an example binding. Commit dd468d4f17 later removed standard extension sources from core during the R5 extension relocation.
additional_context: The current core history page says all extensions moved to hl7.fhir.uv.extensions while still being published as part of the specification. Current core has no active job-title extension files beyond retained canonical OID entries. The Extension Pack checkout contains active practitioner-job-title StructureDefinition, ValueSet, and CodeSystem artifacts matching the accepted semantics. FHIR-15607 is a duplicate/same-change-family PractitionerRole title request and was not independently decided.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. The authoritative source for this standard extension now lives in /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions, so reintroducing or editing extension source in core would be wrong.
